source.note: -L <name>_libretro.so|dll: a bare core filename is looked up in libretro_directory (retroarch.c core path resolution), so the same args work for the flatpak, native and windows builds. 7z/zip are opened natively. -f = fullscreen
source.saves: runloop.c: savefile_directory (empty or savefiles_in_content_dir -> next to the rom), sort_savefiles_enable (default true) appends the core's library_name, sort_savefiles_by_content appends the rom's folder name. file = <rom name without ext>.srm (+ .rtc). archives use the inner file's name.
source.cores: corenames from libretro-core-info: Mesen, Snes9x, Genesis Plus GX, mGBA, Mupen64Plus-Next. linux cores downloaded from buildbot.libretro.com/nightly/linux/x86_64/latest
